order_wins: **Systematic Industries** — receives **Notifications of Award from Power Grid Corporation of India for the OPGW-06 package**, the supply, execution and erection of optical ground wire on transmission lines at pan-India locations, an aggregate contract value of **Rs 82.42 crore** _(~13.4% of mcap)_. The awards were issued on 24 August and signed on 9 September.

**B.R.Goyal Infrastructure** — receives a **work order from the National Highways Authority of India for engagement as user-fee collection agency at the Khambara Fee Plaza in Maharashtra**, won on e-tender, with upkeep of the adjacent toilet blocks, for one year at an accepted value of **Rs 52,39,77,575** _(~12.0% of mcap)_.

**Bondada Engineering** — its joint venture with BEST Infra receives a **Letter of Intent from Northern Power Distribution Company of Telangana for a smart energy metering project of Rs 41,01,42,500 including taxes** _(~1.3% of mcap)_, covering 12,500 single-phase and 27,500 three-phase meters over 11 months from the purchase order.

**Ceinsys Tech** — receives a **Letter of Award from Rite Water Solutions (India) for Rs 28,17,42,382 excluding GST**, to design, supply, install, test and commission station RTUs, FRTU/remote IO modules and allied equipment giving SLDC and ALDC visibility of 125 electrical substations of 132/110/100 kV _(~2.0% of mcap)_. The term is 48 months — 24 of execution and 24 of warranty.

**Ameenji Rubber** — receives a **Letter of Acceptance from the Principal Chief Materials Manager, North Western Railway, Jaipur, for the manufacture and supply of CGRSP, valued at Rs 24,15,37,849** _(~9.9% of mcap)_, to be executed over 24 months.

**Optivalue Tek Consulting** — receives a **Rs 20.70 crore purchase order from Rchobbytech Solutions for the supply of nano drones** _(~4.9% of mcap)_, delivered monthly against an agreed milestone schedule and completing within nine months of the order.

**Optivalue Tek Consulting** — receives a second order the same evening, **Rs 16.25 crore from Aaroosha Technologies for modernisation of the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation website** — design, delivery, demo and audit — over approximately nine months _(~3.8% of mcap)_.

**Affordable Robotic & Automation** — receives **two turnkey purchase orders for the supply of robotic welding lines, of approximately Rs 3,81,31,348 and Rs 6,21,05,000**, for delivery by December 2026 _(Rs 10.02 crore is our addition of the two; ~5.2% of mcap on our calculation)_. Both customers are "not disclosed due to confidentiality".

**Destiny Logistics & Infra** — receives a **work order from Steel Authority of India's IISCO Steel Plant for the extension of the WRM KL and LM bays, sized Rs 6,91,22,294.10** _(~3.1% of mcap)_, on a delivery schedule of eighteen months from the effective date.

**Skytech Infinite Platform** — receives a **purchase order of Rs 4,65,00,000 excluding GST for the supply, erection and commissioning of MCC, APFC and VFD** for the ReNew TopCon project ETP package at Dholera, Gujarat _(~15.3% of mcap)_, over roughly ten weeks. The order comes from a contractor the company cannot name for confidentiality.

**NACDAC Infrastructure** — receives **purchase orders from Godrej Properties for site civil infrastructure works at Godrej DMIC, an order value of Rs 2,83,30,500 before Rs 50,99,490 of GST** _(~11.3% of mcap)_, for execution within four months.

**BCPL Railway Infrastructure** — declares itself **single lowest bidder (L1) on an Eastern Railway, Howrah division tender to replace isolator and drop jumpers, a project cost of Rs 5.89 crore including GST** _(~4.8% of mcap)_. The annexure states the contract is "yet to be received" and dates execution from a Letter of Acceptance.

**Happy Square Outsourcing** — receives a **third extension of its 2023 staffing work order from Madhya Pradesh Power Transmission at Pithampur, approximately Rs 59.76 lakh inclusive of taxes** _(~1.3% of mcap)_, running 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027.
